help.body:
Click Start Piwork, then Open Piwork for account, model and runtime setup in your browser.
Linux needs /dev/kvm; Windows needs WHPX and WebView2.
Choose a data directory before the first successful start, or after a failed session ends. Existing data is retained.
More → English / 简体中文 changes language. The first launch is English; your choice is saved.
Stop and Close wait for Guest shutdown and disk sync. Do not force them.
For startup failures, choose View logs, then Export current log. Export all logs includes only the selected installation. Save and send logs to the maintainer yourself; nothing is uploaded.
If no window opens, follow More → Guide (README) for system component errors; no early diagnostic file is promised.
Technical logs keep their original language; OS dialog controls use the OS language.
See More → Guide for dependencies, data paths and troubleshooting.
For business failures after Piwork starts, use the administrator account menu → Export logs in the browser. Save the ZIP and check its manifest for gaps. Launcher exports cover runtime/startup errors.

confirm.starting.body: Piwork is still starting. Closing cancels startup and waits for ordered cleanup.

confirm.unclean.body: The last shutdown was not confirmed clean. Data is retained and checked on next start. Exit anyway?
